course: Graduate Research School Scholarships (UQGRSS) – includes Research Training Program (RTP)
scholarshipDetail: Financial support for domestic and international postgraduate research students studying the Doctor of Philosophy or a research-focused professional doctorate at UQ. Living stipend of $37,500 per annum tax free (2026 rate), indexed annually, Single Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC). Number awarded may vary.

Provides assistance to students who have experienced educational disadvantage as a result of financial hardship and who are undertaking tertiary studies for the first time. Value: $7,000 per year. Number awarded: unlimited.

Provides financial support to students who have demonstrated outstanding academic achievements during their senior secondary studies. Value: $12,000 per year. Number awarded may vary. Opening date: August 2026. Closing date: November 2026.

course: 4MBS Musica Viva Sid Page Memorial Prize in Chamber Music
scholarshipDetail: Awarded to the student ensemble with the most outstanding performance at the annual competition. Prize includes money equal to the annual income from the fund, a 4MBS broadcast of your performance, and 'Take 3' subscriptions to Musica Viva's Brisbane concert series. Number awarded: 1 (to an ensemble of up to 8 students).
Supports outstanding students undertaking an honours program with palaeontology as their major research topic. Value: At least $4,500. Number awarded: 1.

course: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Research Scholarships
scholarshipDetail: Financial support for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander students studying a Master of Philosophy or a Doctor of Philosophy in any field. Living stipend of $47,500 per annum (2026 rate), indexed annually, tuition fees covered. Number awarded may vary.
Supports students undertaking a postgraduate Bachelor of Arts Honours program in Classical Languages. Value: Equal to the annual income from the fund. Number awarded: 1.

course: ARC Centre of Excellence for Indigenous Futures Top-Up Scholarship
scholarshipDetail: For First Nations researchers looking to undertake a PhD. Provides a top-up stipend of $20,000 per annum and $5,000 per annum research support funds. Number awarded may vary.
Provides support to high achieving students studying Economics (Honours) or Bachelor of Advanced Finance and Economics (Honours). Value: At least $10,000. Number awarded: 1.
Supports a first-year student enrolled in the Bachelor of Music program. Value: At least $10,000. Number awarded: 1.

course: O'Brien Family Prize for Wind and Brass
scholarshipDetail: This prize is awarded to the student with the most outstanding performance in wind or brass at the annual competition. Value: Money equal to the annual income from the fund. Number awarded: 1. Study area: All study areas. Focus: Creative excellence.
Supports a UQ Japanese language student to attend an exchange to Japan. Value: At least $1,800. Number awarded: 1. Study area: All study areas. Focus: Experiences and employability.

course: Burnett William Wendorff Memorial Prize for Classical Piano
scholarshipDetail: This prize is awarded to the student with the most outstanding performance in classical piano at the annual competition. Value: Money equal to the annual income from the fund. Number awarded: 1. Study area: Arts, humanities and social sciences. Focus: Creative excellence.

Provides access to the Mexican population to complete high-level postgraduate students. Value: Partially funded tuition fees, living allowance. Number awarded: May vary. Study area: Agriculture, Architecture, Business, CS, Education, Environment, Health, Science. Focus: Academic excellence, Experiences and employability.

Financial support for a PhD student with an existing scholarship researching mine closure and post-mining transitions. Value: $10,000 per annum + additional living expense support. Number awarded: May vary. Study area: Engineering, Environment. Focus: Academic excellence.

Financial support for research students from China to join the PhD program at UQ. Value: Living allowance, health insurance, return airfare, visa fees, and UQ tuition fee scholarship. Number awarded: May vary. Study area: All study areas. Focus: Academic excellence, Diversity.

Awarded to a music student with the highest overall thesis mark on a topic in musicology. Value: Money equal to the annual income from the fund. Number awarded: 1. Study area: Arts, humanities and social sciences. Focus: Academic excellence.

Enables a UQ student to travel to India for research related to Indian history, culture, religion, or language (max 6 months). Value: $10,000. Number awarded: May vary. Study area: Arts, humanities and social sciences. Focus: Diversity, Experiences and employability.
Supports students undertaking honours study in science. Value: May vary. Number awarded: May vary. Study area: Science and mathematics. Focus: Academic excellence.

Awarded to the student with the most outstanding performance in classical voice at the annual competition. Value: Money equal to the annual income from the fund. Number awarded: 1. Study area: Arts, humanities and social sciences. Focus: Creative excellence.
$15,000. Provides support to students undertaking an Orthodontics field of study within the Doctor of Clinical Dentistry.

course: Faculty of Science Placement Enabling Grant
scholarshipDetail: up to $2,000. Provides financial assistance to Faculty of Science undergraduate and postgraduate coursework students who undertake a work-integrated learning (WIL) placement.
Living stipend of $37,500 per annum (2026 rate) indexed annually, your tuition fees covered. Financial support to cover living costs and tuition for postgraduate research students.
$10,000. To encourage and reward the study of Applied Economics and Econometrics.
The value depends on year, program, and academic field. Financial support covering tuition fees for Higher Degree by Research (HDR) students.
Value may vary. Supports high-achieving students to study the Bachelor of Science (Honours).

course: Howard F. and Gladys Sleath Scholarship
scholarshipDetail: At least $10,000. Supports a first year student in Bachelor of Music studying an orchestral stringed instrument played with a bow.
$5,000. Enables undergraduate students studying Korean to participate in semester exchange in South Korea.
$10,000 tuition fee reduction. Supports high-achieving international students starting a program in Semester 1 or 2, 2026.
